goal: Close GitHub Issue #140: in-scope edits that predate Enrollment can no longer yield a passing QA attestation next to an empty Review revision. Enrollment refuses a scope that is already dirty, and task-path derivation fails closed instead of silently dropping in-scope staged paths.

acceptance.assertion: Enrollment refuses, before consuming the capability or writing any Kernel state, when a path inside the TaskIntent scope_hint is already staged, modified or untracked relative to HEAD; the error names the paths and the rehearsal reports the same condition as a blocker. Dirt outside the scope, the task's own planning sidecar and runtime authority or delivery-attachment paths do not block Enrollment, and a clean scope enrolls exactly as before.

Both task-path derivations (the task index snapshot and the task revision snapshot that QA delivery and the Review revision are built from) throw, naming the paths, when a staged in-scope path is withheld because it equals the Enrollment baseline, so neither QA nor Review can proceed on a path set that omits staged in-scope bytes. Publishing a Review revision with an empty changed-path set is refused. Out-of-scope baseline dirt is still preserved and ignored as before, and an in-scope path changed after Enrollment is still task work. The generated Claude bundle matches the runtime source.
